$comment: Cache of SdkMessage name -> sdkmessageid, required by 'dv pack'.
A packed solution references messages by GUID only (there is no message-name
element in the customizations.xml schema), so the ids must be known offline.
These ids are seeded per-organization and are stable, which is what makes a
solution containing plugin steps portable between environments.
Populate once with:   pwsh build/deploy.ps1 -Environment dev -Task messages
then COMMIT this file. After that 'dv pack' needs no environment at all.
'dv pack' fails with a named list of missing messages rather than guessing.
